rule: A disagreement is published, never resolved by preference. 'Read conflict' means two reads of the same page on the same day disagree; 'stale read' means the published table predates the page. The two are reported apart because only the first is a transcription risk.

findings.finding: No raw response bytes are retained for any injury-report read in this repository: nfl.com is unreachable over TLS from the sandbox's bash (curl exit 35), so every capture is a transcription made through a text-extraction tool.
findings.effect: A transcription cannot prove that no cell was dropped or altered in extraction. The hashed byte ledger claimed by session arena/c0461519-x1 is the fix; until it lands, every injury cell is 'transcribed', not 'byte-verified'.
